title: VLAN Database - VLAN Creation & Deletion
description: Use the VLAN database mode to create, name, and delete VLANs on the switch.
scenario: Use the VLAN database mode to create, name, and delete VLANs on the switch.

concepts.title: VLAN Database Mode
concepts.body: The VLAN database is an alternative way to manage VLANs. Type "vlan database" to enter it. The prompt becomes "(vlan)#".

concepts.title: Creating a VLAN via Database
concepts.body: In VLAN database mode, use "vlan <id>" to create a new VLAN. Then give it a meaningful name.
concepts.code:
SW1(vlan)# vlan 30
VLAN 30 added:
    Name: VLAN0030
SW1(vlan)# name SALES

concepts.title: Deleting a VLAN
concepts.body: Use "no vlan <id>" to delete. Deleting a VLAN removes it from all ports — those ports return to the default VLAN.
concepts.code:
SW1(vlan)# no vlan 30
Deleting VLAN 30...
VLAN 30 deleted

concepts.title: Verifying VLAN Database
concepts.body: After exiting, use "show vlan brief" to confirm the VLAN was created or deleted correctly.
concepts.code:
SW1(vlan)# exit
APPLY completed.
SW1# show vlan brief
